scientific_limitations_integrity.limitations: No conclusion for higher graph powers p>=4 or other cut sizes. Below threshold the new verification is over F_2 only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations_integrity.originality_risk: Existing 2024 tables give homology ranks, but not the new shellings; equivalent unindexed treatment remains possible.
scientific_limitations_integrity.reproducibility: Self-contained Python 3 verifier and two complete ordered-triple shelling data files. All finite claims are exhaustively checked from definitions.
scientific_limitations_integrity.scope: Ordinary three-cut complexes of third powers of cycles; exact shelling certificates for n=13,14; published theorem for all n>=15.

title: The sharp shellability threshold for cubic-cycle three-cut complexes
